subject: Shiny app connection to my work Sql Server

messages.author: 9cf84ff03be05235
messages.subject: Shiny app connection to my work Sql Server
parts:
Hi, I have seen similar questions asked multiple times but have not found a solution that works/makes sense to me.

I have built an app that runs a query on my work SQL server and returns data.

When I run it locally it works perfectly.

When I deploy it to Shinyapps.io I get:
"
ERROR: first argument is not an open RODBC channel"

My code starts with: 

driver.name <- "Driver=FreeTDS;TDS_Version=9.0"
db.name <- "mydbname"
server.name <-"myserverlocation"
user.name <- "myuserid"
pwd <- "mypassword"
con.text <- paste("DRIVER=",driver.name,
                  ";Database=",db.name,
                  ";Server=",server.name,
                  ";Port=",port,
                  ";PROTOCOL=TCPIP",
                  ";UID=", user.name,
                  ";PWD=",pwd,sep="")

dbhandle <- odbcDriverConnect(con.text) 

What am I missing from this? Should I be putting in my servers IP address( I currently just put in the server address on our network)?

Any help would be much appreciated.

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Shiny app connection to my work Sql Server
parts:
The version in the driver name should be 7.2
If the "server address on our network" is a private IP address, this will not work. You need to use a server name that is accessible from the shinyapps.io servers.

If you are still having issues, contact me directly with the full connection text (minus your password) and your application name or id and I can look further.
